scope: Environment Kit phases 1–2, foundation and pipeline; no art or multi-level traversal acceptance

hardware.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (0x00007D55) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

document.renderer: Microsoft Word PDF export; all pages visually reviewed

limits: Headless rendering on actual laptop GPU; excludes physical screen presentation and human input latency
Dedicated 200-module scene does not certify the future complete Q01 scene
Texture bytes are upload-size estimates; browser backbuffer and driver allocation are not measured
Background OS activity and thermal conditions were not controlled
